    ((strftime('%J', T1.time) - strftime('%J', T2.time)) / strftime('%J', T2.time)) * 100 AS percentage_faster
FROM 
    results AS T1
JOIN 
    results AS T2 ON T1.raceid = T2.raceid AND T1.driverid = T2.driverid
WHERE 
    T1.year = 2008 AND T1.circuitid = (SELECT circuitid FROM circuits WHERE name = 'Australian Grand Prix') 
    AND T1.statusid IN (SELECT statusid FROM status WHERE status = 'Finished') 
    AND T2.statusid IN (SELECT statusid FROM status WHERE status = 'Finished')
ORDER BY 
    T1.position DESC, T1.milliseconds DESC
LIMIT 1;
